title: Design: A/P Vendor chip and menu match Inventory Value's
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a vendor with an unpaid bill on today's date, so the Vendor menu lists vendors.
  • Make sure the organization has more than 8 vendors (the Vendor menu shows its search box only when there are more than 8 vendors).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Open Inventory Value (Reports, then "Inventory Value" under PARTS in the left menu) in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the Vendor chip and compare with Inventory Value's Vendor chip.
  2. Click it and read the menu, row by row, letter for letter.
  3. Compare the open menu with Inventory Value's open Vendor menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Vendor: All vendors" with the truck icon, in the resting (grey) style, as on Inventory Value.

Step 2:

  • In this order: a search box with the placeholder "Search vendors", "All vendors", the line "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then the vendors.

Step 3:

  • The same menu: rows, order, tick boxes, spacing and position.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design's pictures for this case were reshot (see below) and will be attached later; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above.

The design's own words:

  • "Vendor chip with the truck icon, as on Inventory Value. Its menu: a search box reading "Search vendors" (shown when there are more than 8 vendors), "All vendors" ticked, "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then the vendors A to Z. Reshot 2026-10-23 (round 15). S5-R13, S5-R14." (caption of "The native Vendor menu")

The design version of 5 Nov 2026 replaced the picture "The native Vendor menu" (reshot 23 Oct 2026, round 15). The old picture ar-ap-p7-the-native-vendor-menu.png is no longer attached to this case; the new picture will be attached later.

Difference from the PRD (DD-02), closed: PRD version 5 said Vendor "exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors")" (S5-R13); the design shows the Vendor menu's search box reads "Search vendor" (singular); alt text: "Search vendor, All vendors and the helper line". PRD version 9 (23 Oct 2026), written after question 12, keeps "Search vendors" and adds that the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors (S5-R13), unchanged in version 11. The design's Vendor menu picture was reshot on 23 Oct 2026 (round 15) and published on 5 Nov 2026; its caption now reads: a search box reading "Search vendors" (shown when there are more than 8 vendors). This case follows the PRD. The held design-version case D-77 (C715559) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).
